about: The Cooks' Guild and the land between Barbarian Village and Varrock (Edgeville piece step 9): the Head chef, Romily Weaklax and the guild's two bankers, and the squirrels and raccoons in the woods west of the village, which have no options but Examine. Types and tiles are mejrs's data_osrs NPCList_OSRS.json (NPCs seen on live, 2026), checked against the 241 cache's types. Every wander range is guessed until recorded.
